ops.statement: A CI gate's self-test must prove the gate works in the CI environment, not just locally. Baselines for env-sensitive tools (pyright, mypy, coverage thresholds) differ between a Windows/py3.14 dev machine and ubuntu/py3.11 CI due to Python version, OS, and stub sets. Preferred pattern: compute the baseline from the base branch at CI runtime in the same job (not from a locally-committed snapshot), so cross-environment mismatch is impossible by construction.
